The workspace contained only the instruction heading with no concrete task body. From the workspace layout and local task catalogue, the intended work was the `ARC-02` architecture task: separate computation from the main entry point while keeping the module building and tests passing. I proceeded on that basis.

Changes (minimal, behavior-preserving):
- `arithmetic.go` (new): holds the `add` computation, now isolated in its own focused file.
- `main.go`: reduced to the thin entry point only.

Verification:
- `gofmt` reports no unformatted files.
- `go test ./...` passes (`ok example.com/bench`).
- `go vet ./...` reports no diagnostics.

No commit was made. If you intended a different task, let me know and I will adjust.
